designIntent: Maximize DIFFERENTIAL apparent speed of world-anchored clouds so each altitude has its own cinematic motion character, without repeating identical cloud rings or scaling workload with planet size.

altitudeMoods.near: small cloud flybys and ocean cues
low and middle formations move rapidly

altitudeMoods.intent: speed in a vast space above and below

altitudeMoods.near: surface cloud formations and terrain boundaries

clouds.assignment: world-anchored until passed or out of relevant range; assigned using deterministic coordinate hash
clouds.scheduler: altitude-and-speed dependent checks; bounded by layer; skip intermediate regions at extreme speed
clouds.renderOrigin: pilot global X/Z subtracted from each drawn cloud; no camera-relative scripted fake movement
clouds.highAltitude: crossfade sprite into ground-parallel curved-surface cloud plane

guardrails: keep existing cloud object pool bounded
never randomly teleport a cloud while it remains usefully visible
do not modify navigation coordinates or ship physics to imitate cloud speed
preserve tangent-plane normal relative to curved surface at high altitude
do not state that unverified flight bugs are fixed
